text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Senlac Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for pedestrian crossing protection on Senlac Road at the York Cemetery and Funeral Centre access. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services is recommending the installation of a pedestrian crossover (PXO) at the subject location. The PXO will provide enhanced safety for vulnerable road users.

North York Community Council: 1. Referred the Item to the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services for further consultation with the local Councillor in the new term of Council and a report to North York Community Council early in 2023.
